events.title: Mick Jagger turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Rolling Stones frontman Mick Jagger celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Rock Icon Turns 83
angles.copy: Eighty-three years young! The iconic Mick Jagger, frontman of The Rolling Stones, is still strutting and singing. What's your favourite Stones track?

events.title: MTV launched 45 years ago
events.blurb: Music Television (MTV) launched on this day in 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' as its very first music video.

angles.name: MTV's First Video
angles.copy: Forty-five years since MTV launched with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star'. Did video really kill the radio star? We're still here!

events.title: Oasis' 'Definitely Maybe' turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis released their groundbreaking debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on this day in 1994, featuring anthems like 'Live Forever' and 'Supersonic'.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Anniversary
angles.copy: Thirty-two years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the sound of British music. What's your top track from this legendary album?

events.title: Woodstock Festival began 57 years ago
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a defining moment of 60s counterculture, kicked off on this day in 1969 in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Peace & Music Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since half a million gathered for '3 Days of Peace & Music' at Woodstock. Which legendary performance do you wish you'd seen?

events.title: Anniversary of Elvis Presley's passing
events.blurb: On this day in 1977, the world mourned the death of Elvis Presley, who would have been 91 this year.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Remembering The King. Forty-nine years since we lost Elvis Presley, a true icon who would have been 91. His music lives on.

events.title: Anniversary of Tupac Shakur's death
events.blurb: Influential rapper Tupac Shakur passed away on this day in 1996, at the age of 25. He would have been 55 this year.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: Remembering Tupac Shakur, who tragically passed away on this day in '96. His powerful lyrics and legacy continue to resonate.

events.title: Anniversary of Jimi Hendrix's death
events.blurb: Guitar legend Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970, at the age of 27. He would have been 84 this year.

angles.name: Hendrix Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled Jimi Hendrix, who left us on this day in 1970. His guitar wizardry continues to inspire generations.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on this day in 1969, featuring classic tracks and that legendary zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. From 'Come Together' to 'Here Comes the Sun', it's pure genius. Still your favourite?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' formidable frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Hynde at 75
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! The voice and force behind The Pretenders, still rocking it. What's your go-to Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis and Beady Eye legend Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: LG's Birthday
angles.copy: Our Kid is 54! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still bringing the rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released 55 years ago
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic peace anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Turns 55
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A timeless message that resonates just as strongly today. What does the song mean to you?

events.title: First iPod released 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod's Quarter Century
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? Twenty-five years since the original iPod dropped, changing music on the go forever. How many songs did yours hold?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the anniversary of the first 007 film, Dr. No, released in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Which Bond theme gets you shaken, not stirred, every time? Let us know your favourite.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon at 86
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're celebrating the life and music of John Lennon. His legacy of peace and powerful songs lives on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Cleese at 87
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true comedy icon. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their sprawling, self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered 'The White Album'. A diverse masterpiece that broke new ground. What's your hidden gem from the double LP?
